title: the aura of the Demonic Path Commander
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji tried to extract more information from the remnant soul, a low roar came from the depths of the Forbidden Grounds, as if some existence that had slumbered for countless years had been awakened.

text.content: The lingering echoes of the bell had not yet faded, and Chen Ji's fingertips still lingered on that line of cold inscriptions. Behind him, Ye Qing's breathing suddenly became rapid—as the Demonic Path Saint, she was all too familiar with this aura. It was the distinctive demonic aura residue of the Heavenly Demon Sect, faint yet pure, as if narrating some unknown secret.

Ye Qing's voice trembled slightly, and that usually cold and elegant face showed rare panic. She stepped forward quickly, her finger hovering above the line of inscriptions, yet she dared not touch it, as if it were some forbidden object. In the dim light, something deep in her eyes churned violently.

dialogue.content: This is the Commander's aura. Three years ago, he entered this ruins alone, and after that, the whole person just...

text.content: Ye Qing didn't finish, but Chen Ji had already understood her unfinished meaning from her pause. He slowly withdrew his finger and turned to look at Ye Qing. In the depths of the ruins, the air was filled with a faint scent of decay, mixed with an indescribable sweet and fishy smell. On the walls around them, some ancient runes flickered faintly, glowing slightly as they approached.

dialogue.content: A complete change in temperament? What kind of person did he become?

More cold-blooded, more... inhuman. In the past, though strict, he never laid hands on his own people. But after returning from the ruins, he began to frantically pursue power, even using fellow disciples' lives to cultivate demonic techniques.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't immediately respond. He moved slowly along the wall, his gaze sweeping across those faint runes. Suddenly, he stopped—one subtle depression caught his attention, for he sensed an unusual fluctuation within it. That fluctuation created some kind of resonance with his Bloodline, as if something was calling to him.

He knelt down, placing his palm over that depression. A chilling energy immediately surged through his palm into his body, intertwining with a dormant power deep in his Bloodline. In an instant, the scene before him twisted—he saw a blurry figure standing in the depths of the ruins, seemingly waiting for something.

dialogue.content: There's... a message fragment left here.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was calm, but his clenched fist betrayed his inner turmoil. The Blood Resonance brought not only images but also fragmented sounds—a man's low murmur, his tone carrying inexpressible anxiety and warning.

dialogue.content: Someone left a message, but I need time to interpret it.

choice.prompt: The Blood Resonance allowed Chen Ji to glimpse a message fragment left by the Demonic Path Commander. This message seems related to his origins and his sister Chen Nian. How should he handle this discovery?

choices.description: Consume more Heavenly Fate, attempt to obtain the complete message content
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate consumption too great, may trigger fatal backlash from fate

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, bit his fingertip, and dripped blood into the depression. The scalding blood bead turned into a beam of red light the moment it touched the stone surface, spreading along the rune patterns. Ye Qing instinctively stepped back, yet she saw Chen Ji's face turn deathly pale, his body swaying yet firmly stabilized. The power dormant deep in his Bloodline was forcibly awakened, and an even clearer image flooded into his mind—

choices.text: Have Ye Qing use Demonic Path Mist to conceal
choices.description: Safely interpret the message with the power of Demonic Path Mist, avoiding detection by the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Safely interpret the message, reduce exposure risk
choices.risk_hint: Demonic Path Mist may interfere with the clarity of Blood Resonance

text.content: Chen Ji glanced subtly at Ye Qing. Without words, she already understood his meaning. Demonic Path Mist quietly emerged from her palm, weaving an ethereal black veil around the two of them. This mist could not only mask their aura but also interfere with the Tianji Record's fluctuations—this was the tacit understanding established from the start of their cooperation.

dialogue.content: Mist is laid, you may begin.

choices.text: First record the location, decide later
choices.description: Temporarily postpone interpretation, first explore other areas of the ruins, search for more clues
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's aura is fading, further delay may cause loss of interpretation opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, leaving a subtle true essence mark on the stone surface with a light tap. This location was firmly remembered by him, but hastily interpreting at this moment carried too much risk. He rose, his gaze sweeping toward the deeper sections of the ruins.

dialogue.content: The aura here isn't from just one source. Follow me.

text.content: As the Bloodline power deepened, that fragmented message gradually clarified. In the image, a man in black robes stood with his back turned, his shoulders and back straight as a pine, yet exuding an indescribable melancholy. That was the Demonic Path Commander—even just a背影, Chen Ji could sense the world-subduing momentum emanating from that person.

Fragmented voices from the remnant soul drifted over, each word like a call spanning across ancient time and space. Chen Ji held his breath, striving to capture every syllable. His heart hammered violently in his chest, as if sensing that the truth about to be revealed would fundamentally alter his destiny.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji, your complexion looks terrible. What exactly is the content?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji obtained crucial information left by the Demonic Path Commander through Blood Resonance. This message involves the secret of Bloodline Twins and an unsettling warning. How should he face this truth?

choices.text: Honestly tell Ye Qing the message content
choices.description: Share all information with Ye Qing, demonstrate cooperative sincerity
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing is after all from the Demonic Path, knowing too much may be dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then began to speak. He narrated everything he saw in the remnant soul—the Demonic Path Commander's warning, the secret of Bloodline Twins, and that chilling sentence. Throughout the narration, he gazed into Ye Qing's eyes, observing her every subtle reaction.

dialogue.content: So... your sister is also a Bloodline Twin?

choices.description: Selectively tell Ye Qing some information, retain core secrets
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing is extremely perceptive, may notice he's hiding something

text.content: Chen Ji weighed his words carefully, telling Ye Qing about the dangers of the ruins from the message while deliberately concealing the content about Bloodline Twins. He noticed a flash of understanding in Ye Qing's eyes, but she didn't press further, merely nodding slightly.

choices.text: Ask Ye Qing about the Demonic Path Commander in return
choices.description: First extract the information Ye Qing possesses, then decide how much to reveal
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may resent his game-playing

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer directly but asked in return: "After the Commander entered these ruins, his personality changed dramatically. In your opinion, what was the reason?" Ye Qing's gaze slightly hardened, seemingly weighing how much to say. After a moment, she sighed and began to tell him some things she knew.

dialogue.content: He... may have seen something here that he shouldn't have seen.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted. Those inscriptions clearly appeared in the remnant soul, each character branding his nerves like a branding iron. Bloodline Twins—these four characters struck like thunder, completely igniting his originally vague suspicions. He thought of Chen Nian, of her various abnormalities before she disappeared, of Mo Xiansheng's words that seemed to want to speak yet held back.

However, what chilled him most was that final sentence. "Before you find her, trust no one"—this was both a warning and a prophecy. The Demonic Path Commander seemed to have long foreseen today's situation, paving the way for Chen Ji with his own experience, even though this help carried enormous risk. Chen Ji closed his eyes, forcefully suppressing the churning emotions within him.

dialogue.content: I don't know. But I know one thing—if you weren't trustworthy, I would have made my move long ago.

text.content: Ye Qing's answer was straightforward and decisive, without any evasion. Chen Ji opened his eyes, meeting her gaze—those clear yet unfathomable eyes. The air in the depths of the ruins seemed to凝固, with only the occasional dripping of water in the distance reminding them of time's passage. He suddenly smiled, that smile carrying a hint of self-mockery and relief.

Before the words even finished, a low rumble suddenly came from the depths of the ruins. The ground trembled slightly, and the runes on the walls suddenly blazed with blinding light. Chen Ji's expression changed—this was the distinctive defense mechanism of the Forbidden Grounds being triggered. He grabbed Ye Qing's wrist, and both simultaneously retreated. The long-sealed stone gate slowly opened, and a wave of even more concentrated demonic aura rushed toward them, mixed with an ancient and dangerous presence.
